transcript: The notion of success has changed with the times Once to rise in a big company And retain a stable position was the typical description of success But today, the younger generation has come to hold different preferences Rather than an expensive car or house, there is a stronger inclination Relation toward free time and meaningful work, freelance work, starting a business remote work New ways of working have gained in popularity People have begun to seek values that cannot be measured by salary alone Sociologists call this change a shift in values Resistance to labels and status has grown And the happiness and health of the individual Have become the prime concern Nevertheless, it is not easy to completely abandon The conventional view of success The expectation of the parent's generation The pressure of society one's own unease What matters is to achieve a life where we feel we are living as ourselves rather than success as described by others Success is to live according to one's own values This may be the definition of success for the 21st century To walk the rough road of life with our own feet That is where truly satisfying fulfillment lies
